provenance.value: npy_datetimestruct_to_datetime (C function in pandas/_libs/src/vendored/numpy/datetime/np_datetime.c; not importable as a Python dotted path from the evidence)

For millisecond resolution (base NPY_FR_ms), timestamps near the minimum int64 range overflow during seconds-to-milliseconds scaling. The conversion takes the checked overflow path (PD_CHECK_OVERFLOW) and fails, even though the value is representable. The old code computed scaleSecondsToMilliseconds(seconds) with no underflow split, so negative values below NPY_MIN_INT64/1000 were rejected as overflow.

The near-minimum millisecond timestamp should convert successfully, as microsecond and nanosecond resolutions already do, by splitting the multiplication so that the negative overflow is avoided (y = a*(x+k) + (b - a*k)).
